##### Project general facts

Terra Grove Layan is an exclusive residential development nestled in the prestigious Layan area of Phuket, offering a harmonious blend of luxury living and tropical serenity. The project features a curated collection of thoughtfully crafted one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments, two-storey duplexes, and penthouses, catering to a variety of lifestyles and investment preferences. Surrounded by lush greenery and located just moments from the pristine shores of Layan Beach, Terra Grove Layan is created for those seeking privacy, comfort, and a refined island lifestyle.

Residents enjoy access to an extensive range of lifestyle amenities within The Momentum District — an integrated community concept centred around a unique network of purpose-built lifestyle hubs. The Business Hub offers a professional environment for entrepreneurs, startups, and digital nomads, complete with coworking spaces and conference facilities. The Gastronomic Hub features a carefully curated selection of restaurants, cafés, and bakeries celebrating international cuisine in a warm and social atmosphere. The Entertainment Hub provides family recreation areas, children’s playgrounds, and social spaces, while the Wellness Hub offers a peaceful sanctuary for yoga, mindfulness, and holistic wellbeing, all surrounded by lush tropical landscaping and green architectural elements. Residents and guests also benefit from direct access to Hotel The Momentum, a boutique hotel offering premium concierge services exclusively for the community.

The project showcases elegant contemporary architecture, spacious layouts, and refined interior design. Expansive windows and open-plan living spaces allow abundant natural light while seamlessly blending indoor and outdoor environments. Premium materials, contemporary finishes, three-metre-high ceilings, and carefully selected furnishings create a sophisticated yet relaxing atmosphere ideal for both permanent living and luxury holiday stays. The overall aesthetic — calm, elegant, and deeply connected to its natural surroundings — creates a living environment that feels both restorative and refined. 

##### Parking
Shared parking.

##### Location description and benefits

The Layan area of Phuket is one of the island's most coveted and tranquil addresses, nestled between rolling tropical forest and protected natural zones that ensure a sense of permanence and unspoiled beauty. The landscape here is extraordinary — dense jungle canopy, gentle hills, and the glittering turquoise waters of the Andaman Sea visible from elevated vantage points across the neighbourhood. Layan, Bang Tao, and Banana beaches are all moments away, offering pristine stretches of white sand and a sense of seclusion that is increasingly rare on the island.

This part of northern Phuket places residents within effortless reach of the island's most celebrated lifestyle destinations, including the Anantara Beach Club, Xana Beach Club, Laguna Golf Club, and Banyan Tree Phuket, all virtually on the doorstep. Porto de Phuket and Boat Avenue provide a vibrant dining and retail scene, while leading international schools including UWC Thailand, the International British School, and Headstart International School are comfortably accessible. Phuket International Airport is reachable in a short drive, making the location ideal for globally connected residents and investors who value both escape and accessibility.

Layan is widely regarded as Phuket's most desirable enclave for high-end living, drawing a sophisticated international community that values privacy, nature, and world-class amenities in equal measure. The area's strict environmental protections and limited land supply ensure that it will remain one of the island's most exclusive and least overdeveloped destinations for generations to come. For investors, the combination of Phuket's booming tourism market, the area's strong rental demand from premium travellers, and the irreplaceable quality of the natural surroundings makes Layan one of Southeast Asia's most compelling long-term real estate propositions.
